svg.title: Orange Face behavior tour
svg.desc: An illustrated Feather with firmware-rendered facial expressions shows gravity rotation, motion readings, three touch zones, shake reactions and three shade controls. Motion and readings are illustrative.

g.text: Turn upright · Tap a touch pad · Shake · Adjust the orange
Illustrated demonstration / Firmware-rendered faces / Example IMU readings
The TFT shows six live readings.
Gravity is visible even at rest.
Hold it upright and turn slowly.
The screen can use all four edges.
Lay it flat to hold this view.
The mouth pulls into a crooked laugh.
The laugh pulls the other way.
Surprise turns into a dizzy wobble.
The rear orange light gets brighter.
Orange Face giggles and glows brighter.
Each tap shifts one shade redder.
The TFT and glow change together.
Each tap shifts one shade more golden.
There are nine steps to try.
Tap BOOT while the face is running.
